name: Omarchy Theme for Ovata
description: Full-workspace Omarchy Linux theme integration for Ovata. Styles all 31 Ovata UI, editor, markdown, and canvas tokens to match your active Omarchy desktop palette in real time via Omarchy's theme-set hook, or lets you manually pin any of the 22 built-in Omarchy dark and light color presets (default: Gruvbox dark).
author: L3SSE
